arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill with a cooldown grants {c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_4|1|]{/c} seconds. 

Wing Strikes gain {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill benefits.

While in {c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} form, your {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[SF_6 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
